title: The Messengership Of Prophet Muhammad 16th Degree 4th Proof The Consensus Of The Prophets

questions.question: What do the prophets agree about besides Allah being One?
questions.answer: They agree that this messenger is true and really sent by Allah.

questions.question: What kinds of things found in the other prophets were also found fully in this messenger?
questions.answer: The special signs, miracles, and jobs of prophethood.

questions.question: In which earlier holy books were glad tidings about him mentioned?
questions.answer: In the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms, and other revealed pages.

questions.question: Besides words, how else did the prophets support his mission?
questions.answer: Their miracles and their lives also showed support for him.

questions.question: Who are the people in the next part that followed his teaching and reached high spiritual levels?
questions.answer: The saints.

questions.question: What two big truths do these saints agree on?
questions.answer: Allah’s oneness and this messenger’s truthfulness.

questions.question: How did some saints come to know the unseen truths he taught?
questions.answer: By the light of sainthood and the light of belief.

questions.question: What does this shared witness show about the messenger?
questions.answer: That he was very truthful and upright.

questions.question: What is one main idea of these two parts together?
questions.answer: Both prophets and saints are strong witnesses that his message is true.

questions.question: Why is the agreement of many prophets and many saints a strong proof?
questions.answer: Because so many truthful people saying the same thing makes the proof stronger.

questions.question: Who gives a strong proof for the messenger’s truth in the fourth part?
questions.answer: The prophets.

questions.question: Why do the prophets count as strong witnesses?
questions.answer: Because the signs of true prophethood were seen in them and also fully in him.

questions.question: What did earlier prophets say about him before he came?
questions.answer: They told people good news about his coming.

questions.question: Did the passage say only a few examples of these good tidings exist, or many?
questions.answer: Many.

questions.question: What did the prophets’ actions show about his mission?
questions.answer: Their actions also confirmed that his mission was true.

questions.question: Who reached truth and spiritual excellence by following him?
questions.answer: Thousands of saints.

questions.question: What amazing experiences are mentioned about these saints?
questions.answer: They had wondrous deeds, spiritual uncovering, and witnessing.

questions.question: What truths taught by the messenger did the saints confirm?
questions.answer: Truths about the unseen world.

questions.question: If both prophets before him and saints after him support him, what can we understand?
questions.answer: His messengerhood is strongly proven from both sides.

questions.question: What does the agreement of the prophets teach about this messenger?
questions.answer: That he was truthful and sent by Allah.

questions.question: What does history testify about him compared with the other prophets?
questions.answer: That he had the qualities of prophethood in a full way.

questions.question: Name one way the earlier prophets pointed to him.
questions.answer: They spoke of his coming in earlier holy books.

questions.question: Name another way the earlier prophets pointed to him.
questions.answer: Their miracles and prophetic work supported his mission.

questions.question: In the fifth part, who is called his followers in the path of spiritual truth?
questions.answer: The saints.

questions.question: What did these saints gain by learning from him?
questions.answer: Truth, reality, perfection, and spiritual witnessing.

questions.question: Did the saints witness only Allah’s oneness, or also the messenger’s truth?
questions.answer: They witnessed both.

questions.question: What subject did some of them see to be true through spiritual light?
questions.answer: Some truths about the unseen.

questions.question: Why does the passage compare this proof to the sun?
questions.answer: Because it is described as very clear and bright.

questions.question: What is a good short summary of these two parts?
questions.answer: The prophets foretold and confirmed him, and the saints followed him and confirmed him too.

questions.question: According to the passage, what is one strong proof from the prophets about this messenger?
questions.answer: Their agreement about him.

questions.question: What three things in the prophets showed they were true messengers and were also found in him?
questions.answer: Sacred qualities, miracles, and prophetic duties.

questions.question: Where did earlier prophets give happy news about him?
questions.answer: In revealed scriptures.

questions.question: What does it mean that the prophets “signed” his mission in a picture-like way?
questions.answer: It means they strongly approved and confirmed it.

questions.question: What group in the fifth part learned from him and then became spiritually strong?
questions.answer: The saints.

questions.question: What did these saints all say together about Allah and His messenger?
questions.answer: That Allah is One and the messenger is true.

questions.question: How did they come to trust what he taught about hidden things?
questions.answer: They confirmed it through faith and spiritual insight.

questions.question: Who is called their master in the passage?
questions.answer: The great messenger they followed.

questions.question: What feeling should a reader get from so many holy people agreeing?
questions.answer: Strong trust that the message is true.

questions.question: What is the difference between the witnesses in the fourth and fifth parts?
questions.answer: The fourth part speaks about prophets, and the fifth part speaks about saints.

questions.question: What does the fourth part say the prophets prove about this messenger?
questions.answer: That he was truthful and a real messenger.

questions.question: Did the passage say the prophetic signs were partly in him or fully in him?
questions.answer: Fully in him.

questions.question: What are some of the earlier books that mentioned him?
questions.answer: The Torah, the Gospel, and the Psalms.

questions.question: What made the prophets’ witness stronger than words alone?
questions.answer: Their deeds and miracles also supported it.

questions.question: What kind of people are spoken about in the fifth part?
questions.answer: Saints who followed his teaching.

questions.question: What did these saints reach through following him?
questions.answer: High spiritual truth and perfection.

questions.question: What did they witness about the unseen matters he taught?
questions.answer: That some of those truths were real.

questions.question: How fully did they accept the rest of what he taught?
questions.answer: They affirmed all of it with certainty.

questions.question: What does their agreement tell us about his character?
questions.answer: That he was honest and straight.

questions.question: In the fourth part, whose shared witness is described first?
questions.answer: The prophets’ shared witness.

questions.question: What do the prophets already agree on before the passage applies their witness to the messenger?
questions.answer: Allah’s existence and oneness.

questions.question: How does the passage connect the prophets to this messenger?
questions.answer: It says the marks of true prophethood were present in him too.

questions.question: What did the earlier prophets announce about him ahead of time?
questions.answer: That he would come.

questions.question: In the fifth part, who gives the next shared witness?
questions.answer: The saints.

questions.question: What did they become through following the messenger’s teaching?
questions.answer: People of truth, spiritual excellence, and deep insight.

questions.question: What two lights are mentioned as helping them confirm his teachings?
questions.answer: The light of sainthood and the light of belief.

questions.question: What do these lights help them confirm?
questions.answer: The truths he taught, including matters of the unseen world.

questions.question: What lesson do both parts teach about following true guidance?
questions.answer: True guidance is confirmed by many sincere and righteous people.
